title: Per-record digests and capture membership
summary: Every @inventarch/graph Node now carries digest, its per-record digest, and recordDigest(record) computes it: the canonical-codec SHA-256 of what the compiled record says (identity, head and section fields with their nested blocks, edges with their spellings, cells, selectors, variants, requirements and schema), without its source path, lines, spans, placement, provenance or compile-time edge targets. Moving a record to another file, shifting its lines, or reading the same text from an adopted or installed mount therefore leaves the digest unchanged while the text compiles the same way, and the digest fits the codec's nesting limit however deeply blocks nest. @inventarch/db snapshots add membership, one {identity, root, band, digest} row per admitted record in records order: root is the longest root that a `@workspace` admitted at the workspace root declares in composition.sources at the record's placement, read relative to the declaring workspace's own tree, else the record's system folder (adopted and installed records included), else .ia/src/floor for a floor record, else its source directory. Every scope gives an admitted occurrence the same row. A sources entry naming an adopted closure by locator declares no root yet. Workspace revisions, the frozen Door get and records output, ia compile artifacts and composition component digests are byte-identical; ia inspect --json and ia-distribution explain --record records now include digest, and so does each node in serialize(graph) and the .ia/.iadb/graph.json cache payload, still tagged ia-graph-1, so an existing cache file is rewritten on the next open. Snapshot retention, staleness and seat resolution are not part of this change.
